source_text.body:
Review email and reminders at end of day
One user runs ChatGPT as a scheduled task to review mail and reminders and list what's undone; another's agent checks Outlook twice daily, summarizes, and queues draft replies.
·
Oct 30, 2026
Done with
GP
ChatGPT
What they did
One commenter said they use ChatGPT scheduled tasks twice a day to check Outlook, then send a summary of anything needing attention and queue draft replies. They also have it check Slack and other tools, with the work happening on a MacBook through a separate Brave browser profile that ChatGPT can drive; another commenter said they use ChatGPT as a scheduled task for this kind of review.
How it went
The reported result was that it handles Outlook checks, summaries, and draft-response queuing, and can extend to Slack and other services. Limits in the thread centered on chat apps like iMessage and WhatsApp, which others said are harder to integrate reliably.
Worth knowing
The clearest catch was setup: one user said the work runs on their MacBook, using Brave as a dedicated browser for ChatGPT to access logged-in services.
Try it yourself
with
ChatGPT
Copy prompt
Every weekday at [time, e.g. 5pm], review my email and my reminders and send me a summary of what's still undone today: unanswered messages that need a reply, deadlines, and open reminders, sorted by urgency. For emails that need a response, write a draft reply for me to review, but don't send anything. End with a short list of the top three things to handle tomorrow morning.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/AI_Agents/comments/1xekr0k/ai_botagent_for_end_of_day_emailmessagingtodo
